label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (xss) alert-TP: User input from getQueryString flows through param -> bar -> inputParam -> input -> new String(input) -> encodeForHTML(...) -> response.getWriter(). The resolved sink value is the user-controlled param value (possibly modified by StringBuilder replace but still attacker-controllable). Although encodeForHTML is called, the data flow confirms user input reaches the HTML output sink. This is a real XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input from getQueryString(L43) flows through param(L68), bar(L83), inputParam(L84), input(L85), new String(input)(L117), encodeForHTML(L113), and finally to response.getWriter().println(L112-L118)
